properties.bedrock_type: Vashon Glacial Till and Advance Outwash Sands/Gravels
properties.mineralogy: Unconsolidated silts, sands, rounded glacial cobbles, and dense hardpan clay
properties.drainage: High-porosity cliffside seepage draining eastward toward Puget Sound / Admiralty Inlet

properties.primary_surfacing: Coarse pebble-and-sand tideline beach, steep bluff erosion face, and cleared upland grassy lawn with unpaved compacted gravel driveway
properties.wear_characteristics: Marine tidal wash lines, natural driftwood accretion, weathered coastal topsoil
properties.micro_grading: Abrupt transition from sea-level intertidal gravel flat to a 12-meter sheer coastal bluff rising to the terraced residential clearing

properties.groundcover: Temperate maritime dry-summer perennial grasses and coastal moss patches
